content: The function RamTst_Resume shall permit the RamTst_MainFunction to continue testing at the point where it was suspended, at its next scheduled call. Testing continues according to the saved test states. The function RamTst_Resume shall change the execution status to RAMTST_ EXECUTION _RUNNING if it has been RAMTST_ EXECUTION _ SUSPENDED .
